label: POC Onboarding: Environment Networks
mcp_tool_description: List or set the networks an environment offers on NIC 1 of the order form. With only onb_environment it returns nic1 (the networks on NIC 1 now) and available (the networks the environment could use), each with its addressing: schema, ipProvider (dhcp, user_static, user_static_or_dhcp, pool, ipam), gateway, netmask, DNS and IP pool or IPAM link. With onb_networks (up to five NET- ids or names, one per line) it makes exactly those the NIC 1 choices, removes the others from NIC 1, removes networks from every other NIC so servers get one NIC, and verifies the result against the environment's possible networks. onb_refresh=true syncs first: the handler's networks (vCenter, SCVMM, Hyper-V, Nutanix, H3C CAS, OpenStack) or the environment's subnets (AWS, Azure, Azure Local, OLVM, OpenShift Virtualization, vCloud Director, Outscale); a subnet sync puts every subnet back on NIC 1, so pass onb_networks with it to re-apply the choice. category tells the next step: addressing (configure each network with onb_network_addressing), cloud_assigns or no_effect (the cloud assigns IPs), none (the technology has no networks). Runs as a job: poll the returned id with fetch_job. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
